source_title: The Pixel 11, 11 Pro, and Fold just hit an all-time low price weeks ahead of Black Friday
source_excerpt:
Google is running a huge Pixel 11 sale across a number of retailers, including the Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold.
If you’re looking at upgrading to a Pixel 11-series phone this year, now seems to be the best time to grab an unlocked model. Google just started a huge Pixel 11 sale at Amazon and Best Buy well ahead of Black Friday. Best Buy even calls this a “Holiday Deal” right on the site, so it’s clear that this is related to the usual big annual Holiday sales events. Here’s the breakdown:
This Pixel 11 sale takes up to $350 off Google’s latest Pixel phones, all packing the same Tensor G6 processor inside, as well as Gemini Intelligence and the absolute latest version of Android. Pixel thrives as the de facto way to stay up to date on the latest tech and always gets Google’s latest Android (and Gemini) features first.
If I had to choose between any of these four models, I’d go for the Pixel 11 Pro , as it packs all the best specs from the other Pro models in a more diminutive-sized package. It’s extremely difficult to find a smaller phone that doesn’t cut corners, but Google manages to make one every year with the same great cameras, displays, RAM and storage configurations, and processor as the larger models. It’s a win-win, in my book.
Keep in mind that the 512GB version has more RAM than the model with 256GB of storage, so if you’re a heavy multitasker, you might want to shell out just a bit more for that model. Thankfully, this great 25% off Pixel 11 sale still applies.
